note: The plain-language line of each counted change that has one, written 2026-10-22. A stand-in until the weekly feed carries a line for every change in changes[]; a change with no entry here shows its date and issuing body only.

BE-E02.text: law creates the duty to use e-invoices between businesses, starting 1 January 2026

BE-E08a.text: law takes foreign VAT-registered businesses without a Belgian establishment out of the e-invoice duty

BE-E08b.text: law excuses the supplier from the e-invoice, but not from invoicing, when the recipient cannot technically receive one

BE-E08c.text: law now cites the European standard under Directive 2014/55/EU instead of naming EN 16931-1 and CEN/TS 16931-2

BE-E11.text: federal e-invoicing site adds answers on rejecting misaddressed incoming invoices and on reverse-charge information

BE-E17.text: royal decree names Peppol BIS (UBL) over the Peppol network as the e-invoice format, from 1 January 2026

BE-E18.text: royal decree adds an article on holding the technical means to send and receive e-invoices

BE-E19.text: royal decree adds fines for lacking the means to send and receive e-invoices

BE-E21.text: law restores the invoice retention period

BE-E16.text: royal decree adds a mandatory wording on invoices of small businesses under the exemption scheme

BE-E24.text: royal decree extends the correcting document to structured e-invoices

BE-E25.text: royal decree requires farmer purchase notes to be issued as structured e-invoices
